# DropBG

> Free AI Image Background Remover built by Hoberg Tools and powered by Hoberg Digital Agency.

DropBG is a web-based utility application that lets users instantly remove image backgrounds directly inside their web browser using local client-side AI processing. It requires no server upload, ensuring total user privacy and instant downloads.
